Name: Ahaziah, King of Israel
Summary: Ahaziah, son of Ahab, reigned two years, walked in his father's ways and served Baal, and after falling through a lattice in Samaria he sent to inquire of Baal-zebub and died by Elijah's word.
KeyStory: Ahaziah falls, inquires of Baal-zebub, and dies.
RelatedPeople: King Ahab; Jezebel; Elijah; Jehoram, King of Israel
LifeLesson: When trouble comes, the god a man inquires of reveals the god he serves.
